turns.user: My sister got me something for my birthday and it's honestly not really me. Am I able to send it back even though I wasn't the one who paid for it?
turns.agent:
Yes — you can still return a gift, even if you weren't the one who paid.

Under our return policy **(cw-returns)**, items bought on Cartwheel can be returned within 30 days of delivery — the window counts from the delivery date, not the purchase date — and they need to be in the condition described in the store's listing. Some stores set their own window that overrides the 30 days, so the specific store matters too.

Since returns are tied to the original order, I'll need a little help to check the eligibility for yours:

* Do you have the order number or a gift receipt from your sister? 
* Do you know which store it came from and roughly when it was delivered?

If you can share the order ID, I can look it up and check if it's still eligible for a return — I can't promise a refund until I've checked the order itself.

And if you don't have the order details handy, I can also bring in a human support agent to help track it down and walk you through the gift return. Just let me know what you'd like to do!
